facts.text: Appalachian State's Watauga Residential College integrates academics and living by having students share meals, live together in the Living Learning Center, and take interdisciplinary seminar classes in their hall.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Watauga Residential College
sources.quote: Students live in the same residence hall, the Living Learning Center (LLC), take many of their classes there, and share meals with each other and with their faculty.
